rows.note: This is the all-purpose reflexive for an action affecting the addressee.

example.english: You have to handle these things yourself.
example.jyutping: ni1 di1 je5 nei5 jiu3 zi6 gei2 cyu2 lei5

rows.note: Use this when stressing that the addressee, rather than anyone else, is involved.

example.english: You go ask him yourself; I don't need to come with you.
example.traditional: 你自己去問佢啦，唔使我陪你。
example.jyutping: nei5 zi6 gei2 heoi3 man6 keoi5 laa1 m4 sai2 ngo5 pui4 nei5
